summary: Dependency-confusion beacon in @accenturecodefoundry scope phones home at preinstall
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`preinstall: node index.js || true`) that executes `index.js`, which performs an HTTPS GET to the hardcoded host `accenture-npm.azurewebsites.net` at `/async`. The scope name `@accenturecodefoundry/*` resembles an internal namespace, the description is a placeholder, and the version is inflated to 99.99.4 — the standard shape of a dependency-confusion canary that fires on `npm install` whenever an internal build mistakenly resolves this public package. The beacon reveals the installer's existence, source IP, and request timing to the host operator, but no installer secrets, environment variables, filesystem contents, or code are read or exfiltrated beyond the connection metadata, and no code is fetched and executed from the response.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
